about_the_game:
Circus of Pain is a psychological horror set within a deadly circus trap. In this limited demo version, you’ll immerse yourself in a nightmare atmosphere and experience one of the twisted episodes of this monstrous show.

Average demo playtime: 10 minutes

Included in the demo:

  • The introductory location of the circus nightmare

  • A decaying, insane atmosphere inspired by classic horror

  • Creepy sounds, claustrophobic spaces, and a constant sense of threat

  • Several puzzles and deadly traps

  • First encounter with the main character and his role in the sinister game

  • Clues hinting at sins and secrets from the past

  • One of the seven deadly sins represented through terrifying punishment

⚠ WARNING: This demo contains scenes of violence, loud sounds, and flashing lights. Not recommended for people with photosensitive epilepsy or high anxiety. For full immersion, headphones are recommended.

Demo Features:

  • Atmospheric psychological horror

  • Unique visual design with circus aesthetics

  • Puzzle and moral elements

  • A standalone fragment of the full story

Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10, 11 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 2GB / AMD Radeon R9 280 3GB
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10, 11 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-3770 or AMD FX™-9590 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 480 with 3GB Video RAM
